problem: Which of the following describes the level surfaces of the function $f(x,y,z)={e}^{-{x}^{2}-{y}^{2}-{z}^{2}}?$

choices.value: A family of spheres centered at $(0,0,e)$
A family of surfaces given by  ${z}^{2}+c={x}^{2}+{y}^{2}$ for $c>0$
A family of surfaces given by ${z}^{2}+c={x}^{2}+{y}^{2}$ for $c\ne 0$
A family of spheres centered at $(0,0,{e}^{-1})$
A family of spheres centered at the origin
